args.content:
Runbook: Context tag updates are replace-only.

Policy: save_*_context(tags) replaces the full tag set for a context. Duplicates are ignored (unique(context_id, tag)). Any tags not included in the new tags array are deleted.

Operator checklist:
- Always send the complete intended tag set on every update.
- Do not assume tags are merged.
- Verify critical tags (e.g., runbook/oncall/security) remain after edits.

args.content:
SupportOps WARNING: Tag updates are destructive.

In Claude Server, save_*_context(tags) replaces the entire tag set for the context. Any tag not included in the write will be deleted; duplicates are ignored due to unique(context_id, tag). Always include every existing tag you intend to keep when updating tags.

(See related canonical note: “Tagging rules”.)

metadata.created_reason: Prevent accidental tag loss during context updates
